metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for the Oracle AI Data Platform Workbench Snowflake Migrator Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: oracle-ai-data-platform-workbench-snowflake-migrator
plugins.description: Deterministic Snowflake to Oracle AI Data Platform migration: scripted discovery, planning, DDL translation and in-AIDP data-migration jobs, driven from one config file. Read-only against Snowflake, enforced at the transport; dry-run by default against AIDP. The control plane copies no data; rows are copied only by the in-AIDP job snowmig_02_copy_schema (INSERT-SELECT, verified by row count and decimal sums), one schema per run, when the operator runs it. Structure and scripts, with a report of what translated, what did not, and why.
